question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

24, 48, 45, ?, 175, 1050
solution:
The pattern applied in the given series is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2b8d0324a537a7d03b91f48a1c76b297530983c968c82c8a51427f3eddff668.png] 

Thus you can clearly see that there are two cases alternatively followed, first a number is multiplied by two and as we further go on it , it will be multiplied by next number by keeping a common multiple of 2 and in next case subtracted by an odd number in a succeeding manner from the previous cases.

Hence **the answer will be option 4)**
